interpretation: The audit separates phase drift from profile drift, but the available gates do not yet distinguish stable frequency shift, structural drift and numerical accumulation robustly enough for promotion.
formal_promotion_blocker: D4 numerical validation and D5 basin-orbital stability were not run in the primary matrix.
interpretation_detail: Through 100 node periods, delta_theta is linear-secular while phase-aligned orbital distance, core amplitude, width, core energy and modal leakage classify as bounded oscillatory. This supports a frequency-shift interpretation of the earlier continuous-drift label, but formal promotion is blocked until numerical and basin gates close.
